title: Single-select poll · 4 options
description: Resource-hub and Nudge emails when intent is unknown. Max 4 options, one poll per email.
usage: Zero-party data capture. Each option is a tracked link mapped to a follow-up journey. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.
notes: No forms or JS. Each option is a bordered row whose radio and label link to the same tracked URL, so each row needs one alias. In most clients the label link is display:block and spans the row.
Max 4 options, one poll per email.

Mobile (ADC snapping): option padding 16/24 → 16 all round (mobPad16; Figma 8/16 — no ADC class for 8px vertical); gap between rows 16 → 10 (padd-none, Figma 8); radio-to-label gap 16 → 10 (mobile-prl, which also adds 10px right padding to the label; Figma 8).
The 4px option radius shows as square corners in Outlook.
The heading uses f24 (28 → 24 on mobile) per CONVENTIONS. Figma's mobile frame keeps it at 28px.
